summary: rustre-symbols-codeview has no dedicated MCP tool surface — it is consumed transitively through symbols_pdb_load (DBI module walk -> .debug$S CV symbol streams) and through symbols_demangle_auto for names extracted by the CV parser. Standalone validator reimplements the CV symbol record walker (S_PUB32/S_GPROC32/S_GDATA32/S_UDT/S_LABEL32/S_REGREL32/S_CONSTANT), the .debug$S subsection dispatcher (signature 4 + kinds 0xF1..0xF5), the TPI leaf walker, the primitive-type index decoder, the PDB70 GUID formatter, and a sanity gate. All eight tests agree with the MCP-exposed behavior: symbols_pdb_load on target/release/rustre.exe returns 316 deduplicated symbols sourced from CV records the validator independently parses, demangler handles MSVC + Itanium + RTTI names that survive the CV record walker, and synthetic round-trips match field-by-field. No mismatch surfaced; no fix required; no rebuild needed.
